title: AGI ALPHA FLYWHEEL — Rejected Quantum Construction Research Handoff
question: What can a successor inherit from a correctly reproduced but already known quantum construction without converting provenance into novelty or venture qualification?
goal: Preserve the known result, its rejected novelty verdict, and bounded next-research prerequisites.

qualification.verdict: Known cyclic-order quantum construction reproduced; heterogeneous-neighborhood variation follows by continuity and is not a substantive discovery.
limits: Native provenance does not establish truth or eligibility

candidates.title: Known cyclic-order depolarizing-channel reproduction
candidates.hypothesis: Superpose cyclic orders of four completely depolarizing qubit channels and herald transmission preserving entanglement; investigate a high-noise quantum link. Known prior art; rejected as a flagship and venture.
candidates.metric: Exact known N=4 herald probability, conditional fidelity and Choi partial-transpose witness; novelty rejection retained.
candidates.target: Reproduce p=7/16, F=5/7 and PT minimum=-1/14 while preserving no-discovery and no-qualified-venture status.
candidates.evidence_needed: Independent local exact Kraus enumeration supports a known result; hardware, resource-matched comparison and commercial acceptance remain untested.

sources.title: Chiribella/Wilson/Chau cyclic depolarizing construction
sources.text: The study owner identifies this paper as direct prior art for the selected construction. No new discovery is claimed.

sources.title: 2025 silicon-photonic experimental prior art
sources.text: The study owner identifies prior experimental work and reports F=0.712 +/- 0.013. The integration adapter does not independently establish this experimental claim.

sources.title: Independent finite exact Kraus enumeration
sources.text: N=4, 256 Kraus tuples: p=7/16, F=5/7, Choi PT minimum=-1/14. Scope is a known mathematical construction, not hardware or channel capacity.

sources.title: Rejected weak heterogeneous variation
sources.text: A small full-rank replacement-channel variation preserves the strict entanglement margin by continuity. This variation does not earn a substantive discovery claim.

witness.purpose: Preserve entanglement in a heralded branch through completely depolarizing qubit channels.
witness.binding_restriction: Each channel alone erases input information in a fixed serial channel use.
witness.proposed_change: Use the already known coherent superposition of four cyclic orders and a heralding measurement.
preserved_obligations: Require same-resource coherent-control comparisons before superiority claims
witness.acceptance: Known finite result reproduced; novelty and venture qualification remain rejected.
witness.falsifier: Known prior art defeats novelty; an equivalent coherent-control comparator defeats a claimed new resource advantage.

rights.source: Exact repository source closure and licenses retained
rights.record: Synthetic physics and owner-supplied research evidence; no customer data or secrets
rights.authority: Local research only; no live ENS, token, trading, funds, or permissions

uncertainties: Native provenance does not establish truth or eligibility
The native source schema does not judge scientific novelty; companion guard preserves the rejected status.
next_experiment: Require a distinct separated useful regime and a substantive prior-art differential against a same-resource coherent-control comparator, including losses, heralding, channel uses, and full costs. This prerequisite is not met.

milestones.goal: Verify the archived independent known result and rejected novelty verdict.
milestones.acceptance: Exact known N=4 values reconcile; no-discovery and not-qualified remain explicit.
milestones.falsifier: Any claimed numeric value disagrees with the archived independent result or novelty is relabeled.

milestones.goal: Keep new research blocked until a separated regime and same-resource comparator are concretely specified.
milestones.acceptance: Report all four unmet research prerequisites and no execution authority; budgets are proposals only.
milestones.falsifier: Ordinary continuity is relabeled a discovery, known prior art is omitted, or comparison resources are unequal.
